configurePresets.name: windows-mingw
configurePresets.description: MinGW port (M8) - run inside an MSYS2 (mingw64) shell, matching this project's CI (msys2/setup-msys2), where g++/gcc/Unix Makefiles are all provided natively - not a cross-compilation setup. See the windows-msvc preset for the MSVC alternative.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: MSVC port - run from an 'x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS' (or with vcvarsall.bat x64 sourced first), where cl/lib/link/nmake and the INCLUDE/LIB env vars are all set up already. NMake Makefiles generator, not Unix Makefiles/Ninja - nmake ships with every MSVC install, so this preset needs nothing beyond the 'Desktop development with C++' workload, unlike windows-mingw's separate MSYS2 dependency. ebc's own backend-toolchain selection (compiler/src/driver/main.cpp's isMsvcToolchain) is independent of which compiler built ebc itself here - it switches to MSVC-style flags whenever -cxx/CXX names cl/cl.exe/clang-cl, regardless of this preset.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: macOS's own system compiler is Clang (Xcode Command Line Tools), same reasoning as linux-clang.

configurePresets.name: haiku
configurePresets.description: Haiku's traditional system compiler is GCC, same shape as linux-gcc. Live-verified on real Haiku hardware (M8e). CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR overrides GNUInstallDirs's generic 'share' default: Haiku's own real data directory is 'data' (confirmed via cmake --system-information's CMAKE_ROOT; /boot/system/share exists but is empty), and GNUInstallDirs itself has no Haiku-specific handling at all.
